description: This file defines a PHP trait 'HasMonitoringEventsTrait' within the AWS SDK that manages client-side monitoring events through methods to get, prepend, and append events.

methods.name: getMonitoringEvents
methods.description: Returns the array of monitoring events attached to the object.

methods.name: prependMonitoringEvent
methods.description: Prepends a monitoring event to the monitoringEvents array.

methods.name: appendMonitoringEvent
methods.description: Appends a monitoring event to the monitoringEvents array.
